from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c5a936fe.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seeds = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    for c, color in seeds:
        markers = [(r, cc) for r in range(1, h) for cc in range(w) if grid[r][cc] == color]
        if markers:
            r, cc = markers[0]
            for rr in range(min(0, r), max(0, r) + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
            for x in range(min(c, cc), max(c, cc) + 1):
                out[r][x] = color
        else:
            for rr in range(h):
                out[rr][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)
transform=ns['transform']
